title: Korean Kimchi Rice Bowl
description: A flavorful and spicy Korean-inspired dish made with kimchi, warm rice, and pecorino cheese.
instructions: Cook the warm rice according to package instructions.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked rice, kimchi, and soy sauce. Mix well to combine.
Transfer the rice mixture to a serving bowl.
Top the rice with crumbled pecorino cheese, chopped green onions, and sesame seeds.
Drizzle sesame oil over the top of the dish.
Sprinkle Korean chili flakes over the top of the dish to taste.
Garnish with additional green onions and sesame seeds if desired.
